subject: assessment-and-announcement
scope: Deterministic assessment pairing, announcement planning, scheduling, and duplicate identity for the Phase 3 Chief of Staff weekly loop. Preview/planning only; no Canvas writes.

twoNoticePolicy.rule: When an approved pacing interpretation contains a test/assessment that requires communication, Chief generates an announcement plan for teacher review.

reminder.leadDaysAuthority: OWNER_POLICY (Phase 3.2 ~1-2 days) consistent with existing ASSESSMENT_REMINDER_LEAD_DAYS=2

twoNoticePolicy.calendarBoundaryBehavior: produce scheduling warning/proposal instead of silently choosing a bad date

sendTime.note: Live assessment reminders use delayed_post_at 20:00Z (4:00 PM ET); weekly agenda updates Friday 4:00 PM ET.

spellingReminderSendTime.note: Live Spelling reminders use delayed_post_at 20:30Z (4:30 PM ET).

pairing.rule: A regular Math test is a cumulative assessment. Math cumulative assessments and Fact Tests are given on the same day. They create TWO separate Canvas gradebook assignments.
pairing.note: For family/student communication they are normally communicated in ONE combined Math assessment announcement.

resourceRule.rule: The Fact Test section of the Math assessment announcement should include the fact skill, the correct mapped Power Up, and a verified Canvas Power Up PDF attachment/link. Power Up selection is deterministic; Qwen never selects a Power Up.
resourceRule.canvasFileNote: No verified Canvas Power Up PDF file ID exists in repo config. Resolution requires a future GET-only Canvas Files sweep. FAIL CLOSED until verified.

pairing.rule: Reading Mastery Tests and Fluency Checkouts are normally given on the same day. They create TWO separate assignments in different categories.
pairing.note: Communication normally uses a combined Reading assessment announcement discussing preparation for the Mastery Test and fluency practice for the Checkout. Do not collapse the two gradebook assignments.

test14Exception.rule: Reading Test 14 has no Checkout; omit Checkout 14 from announcements and assignments.

checkouts8to13.note: WPM/error targets unresolved; owner source required.

spellingAssessment.practiceRangeRule: For Spelling Test N, practice Lessons (N-4) through (N-1).
spellingAssessment.title: RM4: Spelling Test {n}

languageArtsAssessment.note: Audit found live precedent for Shurley chapter test first notices and reminders (e.g. 'Chapter 2 Shurley Test', 'Reminder - Chapter 2 Shurley Test Tomorrow').

historyAssessment.note: Live precedent shows History first notices + reminders + move-notice announcements. Auto assignment creation remains disabled.

scienceAssessment.note: Live Science announcement precedent is empty in the normalized sweep; do not manufacture rules.

customAnnouncement.rule: Owen may supply raw text; Chief collects deterministic facts (raw message, target course(s), requested send date/time, optional reminder), Qwen rewrites for style, teacher approves/edits/regenerates.
customAnnouncement.multiCourseBehavior: one intended Canvas object per course unless live Canvas proves another supported architecture.

duplicateIdentity.rule: Retries must not create duplicates; update/reconcile the existing intended object where Canvas semantics permit.
